entities.name: Luis Rafael Sánchez
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Luis Rafael Sánchez, also known as "Wico" Sánchez is a Puerto Rican essayist, novelist, and short-story author who is widely considered one of the island's most outstanding contemporary playwrights. Possibly his best known play is La Pasión según Antígona Pérez, a tragedy based on the life of Olga Viscal Garriga.
